besluite.fout: Compound written with an unnecessary hyphen.
besluite.rede: The AWS writes this compound as one word; capital and meaning are unchanged, and it matches change 2.

besluite.fout: Compound written with an unnecessary hyphen.
besluite.rede: Same spelling fix as change 1, so the lesson writes both compounds the same way.

besluite.fout: 'die ander aande ... is die skottelgoed sy suster se beurt' makes the dishes the subject of a turn, and a reader stumbles on it first time through.
besluite.rede: The full construction says exactly the same thing (same people, same evenings) and reads clearly without being harder for Grade 6.

besluite.fout: 'so hy trek' copies English order; after a linking adverb Afrikaans puts the verb second, and the word cited as a word has no quotation marks.
besluite.rede: 'daarom trek hy' fixes the word order without moving the meaning, and the quotation marks match how the lesson already marks words Thabo writes.

besluite.fout: Sentence-final 'ook' in 'te vol vir skottelgoed ook' follows English rhythm.
besluite.rede: Moving 'ook' before 'te vol' changes what it qualifies (Wednesday evening is also full, like the afternoon, rather than too full for the dishes as well), so the fault needs a different fix.

besluite.fout: Missing comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: AWS 2017 comma: 'Die laaste paragraaf is kort' and 'sy handskrif word al hoe skever' are each a full sentence.

besluite.fout: 'stuur hom op die veld' uses a place phrase where the action needs a direction, which reads as a translation of 'send onto the field'.
besluite.rede: 'stuur hom die veld in' is the natural Afrikaans for sending a substitute on, and the event and timing stay the same.
